description: Purpose of this region: proposals and ideas that have been put forward but not yet decided on.
content:
This region is where ideas wait.

Belongs here: what is proposed, who proposed it, what it would improve, and what it would cost.

Does not belong here: anything already agreed (scope.org_decisions) or already being worked on (scope.org_tasks). When a suggestion is accepted or rejected, record the outcome in scope.org_decisions and rate the suggestion down so it fades rather than deleting it — the trail of what was considered is worth keeping.
